notes: WIPO front page p01, INID-coded fields from (12) through (84), plus the title at (54). Line 1 is the document's own H1 and line 4 is the p01 page comment; both folded here under rule 8. The abstract at (57) is split out as the next section because the closed list has a dedicated type for it.
Two lines only: the (57) abstract paragraph and its EN partner. No chemistry beyond the compound name.

Starts at the blank line before the p02 page comment, so the description's opening page comment sits with the section that begins on it. The reprinted invention title line at 45 to 46 is folded in here rather than given its own section; it repeats (54) verbatim and is a running title, not subject matter of its own. Body is [001] alone.

[002] to [0012], spanning p02 to p05. Five cited prior-art processes, each with a drawn scheme: US 7,820,863 in [005] with two schemes covering four steps (NMST to NMSBA, NMSBA to NMSBC, NMSBC plus cyclohexanedione to the enol ester, enol ester to mesotrione), then one NMST to NMSBA oxidation each from US 5,591,890 [006], US5424481 [007], CN105669504A [008] and CN106565561A [009]. That is the 8 counted here: distinct drawn or described transformations, not distinct molecules, so the four repeated NMST to NMSBA oxidations are counted once per citing document because each carries its own reagents and catalyst. Type is background per rule 11 even though reagents, catalysts and two temperatures (145 degree-C, 140-150 degree-C, both in schemes only) are named. [0010] and [0011] state the problems with these routes; [0012] is incorporation-by-reference boilerplate with no chemistry, kept here because it sits under the BACKGROUND heading and splitting one boilerplate paragraph out would add a section no downstream pass needs. This is the PRIOR ART route and it has four steps including the acid chloride; the invention's route has three and no acid chloride. Do not merge the two.

[0013] and [0014], crossing the p05/p06 boundary. Typed summary_of_invention as the closest fit in the closed list: these are the aims and the claimed contribution stated abstractly, with no reagent, condition or structure. beneficial_effects was the alternative, since 'economical, efficient and eco-friendly' is an advantage claim, and was rejected because the list describes that value as the standalone CN-style effects section and this document has none. Recorded because it is a real choice, not an obvious one.

[0015] to [0018], p06 to p07, with five scheme spans: the step (i) oxidation at 111, the step (ii) esterification at 115, and the full route drawn again at 128, 130 and 132 under the enumerated items (i) to (iii) at 122 to 127 that continue [0017] across the page break. estimated_steps is 3, the three transformations of the invention's route: NMST of formula (IV) to NMSBA of formula (III), NMSBA plus 1,3-cyclohexanedione direct to the enol ester of formula (II), and the enol ester to mesotrione of formula (I). The route is recited and drawn here but not exemplified: no quantity, temperature, time, solvent or stoichiometry appears anywhere in the section, so A2 should expect reactions without conditions. AUDIT: an earlier version of this map set contains_procedure false and estimated_steps 0 here, to avoid counting the invention's three steps once in the Summary, once in the Detailed Description and once in the Claims. The reference run runs/CN104292137A counts per section instead, recording the same chemistry in its claims, its summary and its examples and emitting summary pathways of its own, so the recall signal is measured per section against that section's own estimated_steps and triple recording is not a mismatch. Changed to match the reference format. The reading of the text did not change.

The DETAILED DESCRIPTION heading, [0019], and the claim-construction boilerplate [0020] to [0028] across p08 and p09. It defines 'comprise', 'one embodiment', 'a', 'an', 'the', 'or', 'about' and the reading of ranges. Printed page 7 (p08) carries no solvent, oxidant, catalyst, temperature, ratio, table, drawing or compound name and exactly one numeral, the 5 in '+- 5' at [0023], which carries no unit and no percent sign. Typed other because nothing in the closed list covers legal boilerplate: it is not summary_of_invention (no technical solution), not formula_definitions (no formula), and emphatically not experimental. No chemistry for any later pass to read.

[0029] opens the term-definition block ('Various terms as used herein are shown below') and [0030] defines the compound of formula (I) as mesotrione with its IUPAC name, followed on p10 by the 'Formula I' caption at 175 and the mesotrione structure at 177. Split from the preceding boilerplate because the subject matter changes at [0029] and this block does carry a formula. Note that the caption is printed 'Formula I' without parentheses while the prose says 'formula (I)'; that difference is consistent throughout the document and is not normalised here.

[0031] to [0045], p10 to p14, the substantive process disclosure and the section that carries the invention's THREE-step count. Three sub-blocks a later pass must decompose: step (i), the oxidation of NMST of formula (IV) to NMSBA of formula (III), in [0031] to [0035] with the oxidant list, the ruthenium catalyst forms and reflux for about 6 to 8 hours, scheme at 181 and at 196 (arrow reads 'NaOCl / RuO2', the one place a scheme names the oxidant); step (ii), NMSBA plus 1,3-cyclohexanedione direct to the enol ester of formula (II), in [0036] to [0038] with N,N'-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide, the chlorinated-solvent list, yield at least 65% and purity at least 85%, schemes at 200, 205 and 207; step (iii), the enol ester to mesotrione, in [0039] to [0043] with sodium cyanide, an organic base preferably triethylamine, and a solvent, schemes at 222, 224 and 226. Typed summary_of_invention because the closed list has no detailed_description value and this is where the technical solution and its key parameters live. NMSBC appears here only in [0036] as the step the invention avoids; it is not on the invention pathway.

heading_text_en: Example 1 - Synthesis of 2-nitro-4-methylsulphonyl benzoic acid (NMSBA) of formula (III) from 2-nitro-4-methylsulfonyl toluene (NMST) of formula (IV):
notes: Boundary called deliberately at 251 so this section absorbs the examples lead-in [0046] at 254, the displaced scheme at 256 and the 'EXAMPLES' heading at 258. The scheme at 256 is Example 1's own: p15.json records its between_markers as [0046] to [0047] and its true printed position between the Example 1 title line and [0047], but build_enriched.py anchored it on the first marker and emitted it before the EXAMPLES heading. Rule 7 forbids opening a section on an IMAGE_EXTRACT, so the only way to keep the drawing with the reaction it draws was to start the section above it. A no-lead-in alternative (a separate 'other' section for 251 to 259) was rejected because it would have stranded a reaction scheme in a non-chemical section. Procedure [0047]: NMST 61.2g/0.278mol, NaOCl 500ml/0.745mol, RuO2 1.5g/0.011mol, reflux 6-8hours, acidify to pH <3 with HCl. Unmarked analytical line at 266 carries purity, yield and melting point for [0047]. Typed experimental_intermediate, not experimental_example, because [0040] names NMSBA of formula (III) as an intermediate and the target compound is mesotrione.

notes: The one genuinely wrong boundary in the document as rendered, and it is not fixable from A0. The scheme at 287 falls inside this section but is NOT Example 3's: it draws NMSBA plus 1,3-cyclohexanedione to the enol ester, and p16.json records its true printed position as between the Example 4 title line and [0050]. build_enriched.py anchored it on between_markers[0] = [0049] and so emitted it between Example 3's procedure and Example 3's own analytical line at 289. Moving the boundary would either open Example 4 on an IMAGE_EXTRACT or hand Example 3's yield data to Example 4, both worse. A2 must attribute the scheme at 287 to Example 4 and must not read a second reaction into Example 3, which is a single oxidation at 20g scale. estimated_steps is 1, the count of the section's actual procedure.

heading_text_en: Example 4 - Synthesis of enol ester of formula (II) from NMSBA of formula (III):
notes: Runs across the p16/p17 page boundary: [0050] at 295 is cut and continues in the unmarked block at 300. Dichloromethane 160mL, NMSBA 27g/0.11mol, 1,3-cyclohexanedione 12g/0.11mol, DCC 24g/0.12mol, about 2 hours at 25-30 degree-C. Its scheme is stranded at line 287 inside Example 3; see that section's notes. Unmarked analytical line at 302. heading_text_en: Example 6: - Synthesis of enol ester of formula (II) from NMSBA of formula (III):
notes: The only example title printed with a trailing colon, 'Example 6:'; kept verbatim. Same esterification at 25g scale, isolated by filtration to a wet cake rather than by aqueous quench. No scheme. Unmarked analytical line at 318 reports 'Solvent recovery >85%' although the written procedure never distils or recovers the dichloromethane; recorded as an observation, not a contradiction.

heading_text_en: Example 7 - Synthesis of mesotrione from enol ester of formula (II):
notes: The only example that makes the target compound, hence the only experimental_example here. Title line at 322 sits on p17 and the procedure at 329 on p18, so the section crosses the page boundary; the scheme at 327 is this section's own and is the enol ester to mesotrione step with a completely bare arrow. Enol ester 20g/0.06mol, dichloromethane 60mL, NaCN 1.2g/0.025mol, triethylamine 6.6g/0.065mol added over 15-20mins at 10-15 degree-C, 2 hours, water quench, DCM distilled off at 35-45 degree-C, acidified to pH < 3. This is the single largest gap between a drawing and its prose in the document: the arrow carries nothing while the prose specifies solvent, two reagents, temperature, quench, distillation and acidification. Unmarked analytical line at 331.

[0054] and [0055], p18. General scope caveats after the last example, so not part of Example 7. Typed other; nothing in the closed list fits a scope disclaimer. [0055] is word for word the tail of [0046] at line 254 minus its opener; that duplication is in the published document, not a transcription slip. [0054] prints 'A skilled art is an will appreciate', with 'artisan' broken into three words; kept verbatim.

Ten claims across p19 to p21, opening 'We Claim:' at 346. Claims 1, 5, 7 and 10 are independent; 2, 3 and 4 depend on 1, 6 on 5, 8 on 7, 9 on 8. Claim 1 recites the three-step route to mesotrione: (i) oxidation of NMST of formula (IV) to NMSBA of formula (III), (ii) reaction of NMSBA with 1,3-cyclohexanedione to the enol ester of formula (II), (iii) conversion of the enol ester to mesotrione of formula (I). Claim 10 at line 380 is NOT that route restated: it is a two-step route to the ENOL ESTER, steps (i) and (ii) only, and it never reaches mesotrione. Claim 5 claims step (i) standalone and claim 7 claims step (ii) standalone. COUNT AND BASIS: estimated_steps is 3, counted as DISTINCT transformations recited, which is the field's own word in the prompt. Every other recitation repeats one of those three at a different level of specificity: claim 10 step (i) is claim 1 step (i), claim 10 step (ii) is claim 1 step (ii), claim 5 is step (i), claim 7 is step (ii), claim 2 narrows the oxidant to sodium hypochlorite, claims 3 and 8 add the carbodiimide and solvent to the coupling, claim 4 adds sodium cyanide and a base to step (iii). Two other counts were available and are recorded rather than hidden: 7 if step recitations are counted across the four independent claims (3 in claim 1, 1 in claim 5, 1 in claim 7, 2 in claim 10), and 4 if separately claimed processes are counted, one per independent claim. A count of 5 separately claimed processes cannot be defended from this text: it needs a fifth independent claim, and the claims run 1 to 10 with nothing after claim 10. The Background's 8 was counted per citing document because each citation carries its own reagents and catalyst; the claims are one document reciting one route, so the same logic collapses the repetitions here instead of multiplying them. No claim carries a quantity, temperature, time, concentration or molar ratio; every condition in the set is qualitative and all numeric conditions live in the description's examples. Two structural warnings. First, claims 3 and 8 are the duplicate pair: both add N,N'-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide and a solvent to the SAME coupling, claim 3 as a dependent of claim 1 and claim 8 as a dependent of claim 7. The redundancy is the patent's own and must not be collapsed. Claim 7 itself recites the bare coupling with no reagent and is broader than claim 3, so 7 and 3 are not the duplicate pair. Second, every claims paragraph is marker:null, so all seven schemes on these pages failed to anchor and were emitted at the top of their page: lines 340, 342 and 344 print before claim 1, 355 and 357 before claim 3, 374 and 376 before claim 9. Their printed positions are inside claims 1 and 10, not where they appear here. AUDIT: an earlier version of this map set contains_procedure false and estimated_steps 0 here, reasoning that the claims recite transformations without conditions and that counting them would triple-count the invention's three steps. The reference run runs/CN104292137A counts per section instead and emits a claims pathway, so the claims are an independent extraction unit there and the legally operative part of the patent must contribute reactions to the gold. Changed to match the reference format. The reading of the text did not change.
